model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH-USD spot price on Coinbase reaches $5,000.00 or above at any point before the market's settlement time, based on the ETH-USD pair on Coinbase.
- "No": Wins if the ETH-USD spot price on Coinbase does not reach $5,000.00 at any point before the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $5,000" means the ETH-USD price on Coinbase trades at or above $5,000.00 at any moment during the market's observation window, not only at the settlement time itself.
